title: Explosive mechanism of red jets Heterosigma akashiwo and Chaetoceros mulleri under different culture conditions
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00071H, Paper
Weijie Pan, Meilin Wu, Hui Zhao
Heterosigma akashiwo and Chaetoceros mulleri are prominent red tide species in the South China Sea, yet their outbreak mechanisms remain poorly understood.
